attrs.label: Ciphera Captcha
attrs.heading: Stop bots without <br class="hidden sm:inline">compromising privacy.
attrs.body: Adaptive proof-of-work, puzzle challenges, and behavioral analysis — all without tracking your users. Fully stateless, self-hosted, and GDPR compliant by design.

attrs.label: 01 · Bot defense
attrs.heading: Invisible to humans. Expensive for bots.

text.text: Ciphera's proof-of-work runs silently in a Web Worker — users see nothing while their browser solves a SHA-256 challenge in the background. Difficulty adapts per-IP based on request rate, scaling from easy to hard as suspicious activity increases.

bullets.text: Zero friction — runs invisibly in a background thread
Adaptive difficulty (4-6 leading zeros) based on request rate
Web Worker keeps the UI fully responsive
Graceful fallback to main thread on older browsers

items.title: Human challenge
items.body: When stronger proof is needed, a drag-to-fit SVG puzzle resists ML and OCR, verifies statelessly via HMAC-signed positions, and ships an audio fallback (WCAG 2.1 AAA).

items.title: Risk scoring
items.body: Every check returns a 0–100 score from solve time, behavioral entropy, IP activity, and request patterns — your backend sets the threshold, strict or lenient.

attrs.label: 03 · Stateless
attrs.heading: No database. No sessions. No state.

text.text: Challenges are HMAC-signed instead of stored — the server verifies its own signature, not a database record. This means zero state to manage, horizontal scaling without session affinity, and no cleanup jobs. JWT tokens bind to IP, action scope, and unique ID for replay prevention.

bullets.text: Horizontal scaling with no session affinity
JWT tokens scoped to action (login vs upload)
Zero-downtime key rotation via comma-separated HMAC keys

attrs.label: 04 · Data residency
attrs.heading: Hosted in Switzerland. Zero telemetry.

text.text: Ciphera Captcha runs entirely on our own infrastructure, with no external dependencies. No telemetry sent to Google, Cloudflare, or any third party. Client IPs are SHA-256 hashed before embedding in tokens — we verify without storing identities.

bullets.text: IP addresses hashed, never stored in plaintext
Behavioral signals are optional and session-scoped
Tokens auto-expire with JTI replay prevention
Audio samples embedded in binary — no TTS API

attrs.intro: Most captcha services track your users and send telemetry to third parties. Ciphera Captcha is self-contained. For the full breakdown, read Ciphera Captcha vs reCAPTCHA, Turnstile & hCaptcha.
